entities.name: Query protein 696 aa
observations: Sequence length is 696 aa; calculated mass is 72.3 kDa; theoretical pI is 9.15; predicted soluble and strongly basic from sequence composition.
Pfam-like hits: DAO at residues 10-113, YjeF_N at 214-382, and Carb_kinase at 438-665; these assignments are sequence-based and do not by themselves establish three independent activities.
The sequence shares 33.4-37.1% identity over about 70% of its length with curated bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr homologs.

Most probable role is NAD(P)HX metabolite repair: epimerization of NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX; exact activity remains an inference from homologs, not a direct assay of this sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence analysis, Pfam scan, and homolog annotation

entities.name: Nnr NAD(P)HX repair enzyme
observations: Curated homologs Q83CM5, P37391, and Q8DGC3 are annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes.
Annotated activities are NAD(P)HX epimerase activity (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)HX dehydratase activity (EC 4.2.1.136).
The dehydratase reaction converts (6S)-NAD(P)HX plus ADP to NAD(P)H plus AMP and phosphate; the epimerase interconverts (6R)- and (6S)-NAD(P)HX.
Curated homologs bind one potassium ion per subunit and participate in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.

source_tools.relevance: Curated Swiss-Prot homolog annotations and Rhea/GO mappings

entities.name: NAD(P)HX metabolite repair
observations: Repairs hydrated NADH/NADPH, damaged cofactors generated by enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration, thereby restoring usable NADH/NADPH pools.
Associated GO processes include metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

source_tools.relevance: GO and curated homolog functional annotations
